name: BAW 817 鸟击 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is BAW 817, you are at stand 215, contact Wuhan Ground and request a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 BAW 817，停在 215 机位，联系武汉地面，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, stand 215, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，215 机位，请求拖车。

cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, it's Airbus 330. It's Airbus 330, BAW 817
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，这是 Airbus 330。这是 Airbus 330，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, the tug is on the way.
B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, request facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好推出和开车，请求机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, request push back and start up, facing east.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，请求推出开车，机头朝东。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 04, you notice the wind sock shows strong wind, contact Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，发现风向袋显示风较强，联系武汉塔台核实风况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, holding point Runway 04, the wind sock shows strong wind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，跑道 04 等待点，风向袋显示风较强，请求风况检查。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 817, wind 200, 8 meters per second.
B: the tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Wuhan Tower to change to Runway 22and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： BAW 817，风向 200，风速 8 米/秒。
B： 顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系武汉塔台请求更换至 Runway 22 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 22. the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 22, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换至 Runway 22。顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换至 Runway 22，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: After departure, you encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked, this is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：离场后你遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹，发出紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure/Approach, BAW 817, we encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场/进近，BAW 817，遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹。

cards.audioText: tell the controller you want to dump fuel and return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员你想放油并返场落地。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, BAW 817, request dump fuel and return to land. request dump fuel and return to land, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，BAW 817，请求放油并返场落地。请求放油并返场落地，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: BAW 817, turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO030 radial inbound, climb to 3,300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 817，右转航向 240，切入 LKO030 向台径向线，爬升至 3,300 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO030 radial inbound, climb to 3300 meters, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 LKO030 向台径向线，爬升至 3300 米，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, after passing LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 817，过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over LKO, report it to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 LKO，向武汉进近报告。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 817, how long do you need to dump fuel?
B: tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： BAW 817，你需要多长时间放油？
B： 告诉管制员你大约需要 25 分钟。
cards.referenceText: BAW 817, we need about 25 minutes. We need about 25 minutes, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: BAW 817，我们大约需要 25 分钟。我们大约需要 25 分钟，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed fuel dumping, report it to the controller and request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成放油，向管制员报告并请求雷达引导至跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 817, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 817，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, turn right, direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 817，右转直飞 DA，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach Runway 22, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS Runway 22, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, established ILS Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，已建立跑道 22 ILS。

cards.audioText: B: During landing, you encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：着陆过程中，你在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, we encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，我们在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you find the APU is inoperative, report this situation to Wuhan Ground and request ground power unit ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，你发现 APU 失效，向武汉地面报告并请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, our APU is inoperative, request ground power unit ready at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，APU 失效，请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。
